skills.name: ddna-engineering
skills.description: Shape DDNA requirements and Intent, run engineering skills and generation, and access project-bound Gitea from a connected AI client.

skills.name: ddna-requirement-ide
skills.description: Use DDNA's approval-only Requirement IDE through the DDNA MCP tools for requirement review, closeout, evidence, and proposal decisions.

skills.name: ddna-setup
skills.description: Connect or reconnect DDNA in Claude, ChatGPT, or Codex by signing in to an existing DDNA account with OAuth. Use when DDNA is not connected or reports an authentication or permission failure.

commands.name: ddna-proposal-apply
commands.description: Approve or reject an existing DDNA Requirement IDE proposal after the user decides.

commands.name: ddna-requirement-closeout
commands.description: Close out a DDNA requirement: find gaps, ask for missing evidence, and draft reviewable proposals.

commands.name: ddna-requirement-review
commands.description: Review a DDNA project's requirements with the workbench assistant.
